english: I'm the doctor, I'm going to check your eyes.
target: 我係醫生，我幫你檢查對眼。
romanisation: Ngo5 hai6 ji1sang1, ngo5 bong1 nei5 gim2caa4 deoi3 ngaan5.

english: Does it hurt? Point to where.
target: 痛唔痛？邊度痛？指俾我睇。
romanisation: Tung3 m4 tung3? Bin1dou6 tung3? Zi2 bei2 ngo5 tai2.

english: Please read the smallest line you can see.
romanisation: Cing2 duk6 nei5 tai2dou2 zeoi3 sai3 go2 hong4.

english: Tell me if you see the light move.
romanisation: Gin3dou2 gwong1 juk1 cing2 waa6 ngo5 zi1.

english: Do you see two of me?
romanisation: Nei5 hai6mai6 gin3dou2 loeng5 go3 ngo5?

english: Is it worse looking this way?
romanisation: Mong6 ni1bin1 wui5 m4 wui5 jim4zung6 di1?

english: Look at my finger. Don't move your head.
target: 望住我隻手指，唔好郁個頭。
romanisation: Mong6zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2zi2, m4hou2 juk1 go3 tau4.

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
I'm going to put drops in your eye.
romanisation: Ngo5 jiu3 bong1 nei5 dik6 ngaan5joek6seoi2.

english: This is an analgesic for your eyes. It may sting for a few seconds.
target: 呢啲係眼嘅麻藥，可能會刺痛幾秒。
romanisation: Ni1di1 hai6 ngaan5 ge3 maa4joek6, ho2nang4 wui5 ci3tung3 gei2 miu5.

english: This drop will dilate your pupils.
Your vision will be blurry for about 6 hours.
target: 你嘅視力會矇大概六個鐘。
romanisation: Nei5 ge3 si6lik6 wui5 mung4 daai6koi3 luk6 go3 zung1.
Go3 tau4 m4hou2 hoeng3 hau6 teoi3.

english: The light is bright. Please bear with it.
romanisation: Go3 dang1 hou2 gwong1, cing2 jan2 jat1 jan2.

english: I'm going to touch your eyelid.
romanisation: Ngo5 jiu3 dim6 jat1 dim6 nei5 ge3 ngaan5pei4.

english: The exam is finished. Thank you.
We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
target: 我哋會搵翻譯同你解釋結果。
romanisation: Ngo5dei6 wui5 wan2 faan1jik6 tung4 nei5 gaai2sik1 git3gwo2.
